1. (Currently amended) A method comprising: receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations; automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the bankruptcy documents include unique identifiers for each creditor.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations, and the unique identifiers facilitate tracking of the bankruptcy documents.

6. (Currently amended) A method comprising: receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim; automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each proof of claim includes a unique identifier associated with the respective creditor.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations, and the unique identifiers facilitate tracking of the proofs of claims. 

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages notify the creditors that various debtors have filed for bankruptcy, and the messages include the unique identifiers associated with the creditors.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using a secure file transfer protocol, and the requests include the unique identifiers for each creditor.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via a Web site, and the requests include the unique identifiers associated with the creditors.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day, and the batch filing includes the unique identifiers for tracking.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising: generating a report; and sending the report to a particular creditor, wherein the report includes the unique identifiers for the proofs of claims filed.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site, and the report includes the unique identifiers associated with the proofs of claims.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed, and the aging report includes the unique identifiers for tracking.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim, wherein the filing receipt includes the unique identifier associated with the proof of claim.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer, and the server computer utilizes the unique identifiers for tracking the filed proofs of claims.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record, wherein the validation process includes checking the unique identifiers associated with the creditors.
